instrument: LRO Lunar Exploration Neutron Detector (LEND) RDR RSCI
provenance_note: MANDATORY RULE: LEND measures neutron flux (counts/sec), not water ice directly. Epithermal neutron suppression is a proxy for hydrogen enrichment. Not confirmed water. Radiation dose cannot be derived from LEND.

orbit_observations.interpretation: Consistent with hydrogen enrichment / possible volatile concentration in cold trap
Shoemaker Crater rim: suppressed neutron flux relative to dry lunar highlands
Illuminated ridge: nominal dry regolith baseline, zero hydrogen suppression
Nobile region: moderate hydrogen signature near shadowed crater wall
